units.W: physical source variable/cell slots per respondent
units.S: other static family objects (universe, respondent identity, authority, source relation, four replay-binding families)
units.M: N + Q + E + C + R + G + S all-thirteen-family object count
units.B: canonical body bytes (sum over families of object count times canonical row size)
units.J: one exact-body journal bytes (B plus framing)
units.I_q2: Q2 direct I02 certificate SQLite bytes
units.I_w: frozen writer second I02 certificate SQLite bytes
units.O: occurrences per realized response cell (>=1 for repeated/ranked)
units.Q_ops: distinct operations in a run (1, 10 or 100)

current_work_model.label: analytic
current_work_model.source_open: 1 decode for fixture; original source adds 1 prehash pass (source_reads=2, prehash_passes=1 in SourceI02Stats)
current_work_model.q2_i02_build: O(M) SQLite rows plus indexes, I_q2; one full object pass
current_work_model.body_journal_write: O(M) exact-body journal, J; all 13 families
current_work_model.parquet_write: O(M) rows, P; body_json plus 18 typed lanes plus event locator
current_work_model.second_i02_build: O(M) SQLite rows plus indexes, I_w; duplicate certification
current_work_model.physical_reread: O(M) rows, P read/decompressed; reconstruct body and _row parity against second certificate
current_work_model.session_build: O(N+E+C+R+G) objects read; I_idx SQLite postings; full event/locator body validation and side-family scan
current_work_model.query: selected row groups plus output facts/replay/references

proposed_work_model.label: analytic
proposed_work_model.source_open: unchanged: 1 decode fixture, original prehash+snapshot as today
proposed_work_model.one_journal_write: O(M), J; merge Q2 3-family spool and bridge 13-family journal
proposed_work_model.single_i02_build: O(M), I_q2; Q2 certificate from source-derived stream; no writer second build
proposed_work_model.one_journal_replay: O(M), J; writer consumes exact bodies and checks against Q2 certificate
proposed_work_model.parquet_write: O(M), P; unchanged canonical body/typed layout
proposed_work_model.physical_reread: O(M), P; full body/lane proof against Q2 certificate; all-family ref/selector fields; no sampling
proposed_work_model.cold_qualification: O(N+E+C+R+G) once per release; full event/locator and side-family proof; persist small qualification receipt
proposed_work_model.derived_index_build: O(N+E+C+R+G) once per release or on mismatch; retained content-addressed index I_idx
proposed_work_model.fresh_process_repeat: O(P) cold hash + O(1) index open + selected row groups + output; no full body/session scan

asymptotic.label: analytic
asymptotic.q2_certificate: Theta(M) disk rows with SQLite sorting/indexes; no all-object Python list; chunked commits
asymptotic.index_build: Theta(N+E+C+R+G) once; index size Theta(N+E+C+R+G) with constants
asymptotic.query_repeat: Theta(selected postings + selected row-group bytes + output facts), independent of total E except index lookup; no per-op O(E) rebuild
asymptotic.multi_universe: sum over U exact universes; no cross-wave pooling; per-universe denominators and indexes
asymptotic.retained: P + I_idx + small manifest/receipt; Q2 certificate retained only if owner requires at-rest re-verifiable source comparison
asymptotic.scratch: J + I_q2 + seen refs + stage; no I_w, no duplicate 3-family journal representation
asymptotic.rss: bounded by chunk_rows, Arrow row-group buffer and SQLite cache_size=-2048; Q2 static-family tuples retain residual O(N+Q+R+G) objects

density.label: analytic
density.explanation: 3.245 events/respondent is a sparse canary, not a dense 600-1300-slot survey. It cannot establish 100k production retained/scratch/RSS/query cost. A fully realized 600-slot survey is ~60M events before routing/missing/repeated occurrences; the canary is not representative.
density.old_note: The old 100k/200k witness is even sparser; do not compare merely because both say 100k.

scenarios.label: extrapolated
scenarios.current: cited W1 cost; analytic 8 object passes + 2 hash + full session scan
scenarios.proposed: analytic 6 object passes + 2 hash + one qualification/index build
scenarios.claim: Removes one I_w-class 4.39GB certificate and duplicate 3-family journal; first op still pays qualification. No timing prediction.

scenarios.label: extrapolated
scenarios.current: prepared-session 1.69-1.70x author report only; no independent G5
scenarios.proposed: one cold hash + index open per fresh process; selected row groups per op; qualification once
scenarios.claim: The economic gain is structural (no O(E) rebuild), not a claimed wall-clock speedup; measurement required.

scenarios.label: extrapolated
scenarios.current: per-process PreparedI03Session reuse if same process; otherwise full scan each new process
scenarios.proposed: durable index across processes; index invalidated on manifest/I02/source/authority change; rebuild from canonical on mismatch
scenarios.claim: Index is not disposable by declaration; it is bound and retained. If index cannot be bound/verified, fall back to full qualification, not stale reuse.

scenarios.label: extrapolated
scenarios.shape: dense illustrative 100k x 600 slots, one event/slot, O=1
scenarios.claim: Not a prediction; shows scale. Current O(M) proof/scan and proposed O(M) build with once-only qualification; query remains selected. Retained/staging scale with E and body bytes; 6GiB RSS must be measured, not inferred.

scenarios.label: extrapolated
scenarios.claim: Bodies and indexes partition by exact universe; total O(sum M_u). No cross-wave body pool; cross-universe query requires SourceUniverseRelation and separate denominators. Construction cost is additive, not a pseudo-person merge.

byte_amplification_observations.label: analytic
byte_amplification_observations.warning: Staging 5.26GB and I_w 4.39GB are disk, not RSS. Q2 certificate size is not separately reported; do not assume zero. The 3033.7s witness is sourcefree/cut-specific; no native/100k/6GiB acceptance.

cost_of_reductions.label: analytic
cost_of_reductions.saves: one O(M) certification and I_w (4.39GB witness class)
cost_of_reductions.cost: physical verifier must query Q2 certificate and compare all family fields; Q2 certificate must be available until publish; fallback if not
cost_of_reductions.integrity: neutral if full physical proof against Q2 remains; weaker if verifier only samples or only checks event family

cost_of_reductions.label: analytic
cost_of_reductions.saves: one duplicate 3-family journal write/read and one re-canonicalization pass
cost_of_reductions.cost: defer Q2 spool cleanup until writer finish; one journal lifecycle/lease; no canonical change
cost_of_reductions.integrity: neutral if journal line identity/count/absence and Q2 root equality remain

cost_of_reductions.label: analytic
cost_of_reductions.saves: per-session O(N+E+C+R+G) scan and I_idx scratch rebuild
cost_of_reductions.cost: retain I_idx (1.30GB witness) and a small receipt; index build once; invalidation logic
cost_of_reductions.integrity: neutral if index is non-authoritative, content-bound, rebuildable, and current authority still checked per op; weaker if stale index reused after revocation

cost_of_reductions.label: analytic
cost_of_reductions.saves: no partial target window; avoids manual orphan cleanup and unsafe deletion
cost_of_reductions.cost: one fsynced stage + rename/lease; recovery logic

rss_and_6gib.label: analytic
rss_and_6gib.current_witness_rss: not reported in the cited values; 5.26GB/4.39GB/1.30GB are disk/staging/index sizes
rss_and_6gib.old_w2_rss: 5.923GB persistence; 6.468GB saved-artifact peak; old path, not current S2-C
rss_and_6gib.bounded_pattern: chunk_rows<=8192, SQLite cache_size=-2048, temp_store=FILE, bounded row-group reads, no pq.read_table whole-table, no full C11 graph
rss_and_6gib.residual: Q2 projection static tuples and per-session respondents dict are O(N+Q+R+G) resident; journaling does not remove them
rss_and_6gib.claim: No 6GiB pass claimed. A process-tree RSS measurement with the fixed 13-family witness is indispensable before any 6GiB claim.

peak disk by artifact class (journal, Q2 cert, second cert, Parquet, index)
cold 1/10/100 operations with and without durable index
chunk_rows 512 vs 1024/2048/4096 on narrow and wide queries
crash injection at each publish step
